hypothesis: At the identical rank-40 binary-right plus signed-INT4-left representation rate, selecting right factors in the real residual-output geometry and lifting them through calibration activations will reduce disjoint-validation complete-MLP squared error by at least five percent versus frozen weight-space right factors.

clark_hash_source.method_reused: asymmetric evaluation: stored row sketches are paired with an uncompressed live query sketch
clark_hash_source.material_extension: replace a stateless sparse sketch with an activation-output-optimal binary right factor while retaining asymmetric A(Cx) execution

geometry.calibration_activations: X with n real calibration rows and d model features
geometry.residual_outputs: Y equals X times the transpose of the exported-ternary weight residual
geometry.initial_output_subspace: rank-40 randomized SVD of the concatenated gate/up residual outputs; down is fitted independently on the candidate SwiGLU intermediate
geometry.dual_lift: C transpose equals X transpose times inverse(X X transpose plus lambda I) times F
geometry.export: binary-quantize every row of C with one FP16 scale, refit per-output signed-INT4 A, and retain the lowest exported calibration error
geometry.alternation: after each exported A, solve the ridge-optimal sample feature matrix B equals Y A inverse(A transpose A plus lambda I), lift B through X, and re-export C and A
geometry.runtime_algebra: T x plus A times C x
geometry.gate_up_reuse: gate and up share one C x feature vector
geometry.rate_change_vs_parent: exactly zero; tensor shapes, rank, ternary backbone, binary signs/scales, INT4 codes/scales, headers, and scale codec are identical

parents.activation_cache_contract: up to 256 calibration and 96 disjoint validation rows from the exact BF16 layer-0 prefix; no evaluation item in either split

controls.primary: same exported ternary backbone and activation-calibrated INT4 left factors using the frozen weight-space binary right factors
controls.direct: same exported row-normalized exact-half-support ternary matrices with no residual factor
controls.rate_and_runtime: candidate and primary control have identical component bytes and A(Cx) operator shapes
controls.selection: calibration outputs select the best exported iterate; validation outputs are never used for iteration or checkpoint selection

decision_policy: a failed or infrastructure-invalid weight-binary parent does not authorize this run
a frozen-right activation rejection remains a valid control and does not change this method or its thresholds
a rejection is terminal for this exact rank seed ridge and iteration contract and does not authorize a sweep
a pass authorizes one complete factor codec and end-to-end Qwen3.8-27B capability and paired CPU gate only
component loss or a constructed synthetic example is not model capability or a breakthrough
